description: NWS forecast: Official 7-day forecast periods for a US coordinate from the National Weather Service API (free, no key): temperature, precipitation chance, wind, short and detailed text. Source: NOAA/NWS api.weather.gov. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: place, office, grid, periods[{name, start, end, temperature, precip_chance_pct, wind, short, detailed}].
name: x420_weather_forecast
